show sunday
I had a weird dream last night.
I know that’s not really an uncommon thing to say at this point considering that I’ve even begun showing some of them to you, but this one was particularly strange even by my standards.
I possessed the body of a woman — not in the sense that I kept her chained up in a secret room of my house, but in the sense that I was quite literally inside of her body.
But it wasn’t like it was just my penis that was inside of her body. It was all of me. But not in a vore kind of way. Like, basically, I was just a woman.
I wandered through the halls of an abandoned mall and came across a 500 yen coin that no vending machine would ever accept no matter how many times I tried to dump my findings into them.
Eventually, there was a small man who offered to take the coin off my hands so long as I accepted his mystery box.

I took him up on the deal. And when I opened the box, there was a small child inside — wrapped in foil like a hot sweet potato, but one I could not legally take a bite of without incurring the wrath of the government.
I took him home and fed him. I gave him a pile of dirt to play in and made sure to change the bulbs of his heat lamp every time it would start to dim.
Eventually, he grew into me and tried to give me (female version) a hug. So of course, I accepted.
But when our skin made contact, I woke up in bed with a particularly grumpy yet despondent redhead staring down at me.
scene campingtime2
And that’s basically how I wound up here.
: You don’t seem very excited to be going camping anymore, Ami.
: Probably because you failed to mention the part about how we’d be going along with a bunch of older women.
: Does that really change anything? Besides, you wouldn’t have agreed to come if I’d told you.
: So you just tricked me instead?
: That’s right. And I regret nothing as this will ultimately bring us closer together.
: Besides, there’s no way you didn’t realize last night that someone else was involved in this.
: Obviously.
scene campingtime3
: But I sure didn’t expect it to be three of them and that we’d all be going together.
: My friend Yuki is coming too. But we didn’t have room in the car, so she’s just going to meet us there.
: You know you can drive a little faster, right Maki?
: No can do, Haru-kun. I’ve got precious cargo along for the ride this time.
scene campingtime4
: Kun?
: That’s right. Because the boys are back in town and you’ll never guess what they do. They camp.
: What?
: That’s us. We’re the boys.
: I’m confused.
: So! Ami, have you ever gone camping before?
scene campingtime5
: No.
: Then, are you excited to try it out for the first time?
: I’m only doing this because Sensei said it would be good for our relationship and my entire life revolves around making him happy.
scene campingtime6
: Ami, be more polite to Sara. She’s never done anything to get on your bad side before.
: It’s fine, Sensei. I kind of get where she’s coming from.

: I used to drag Sana around to go shopping when she was little and that was never really her thing. So if Ami’s only here to please you, that’s fine by me. We’ll all end up at the same place either way.
: I don’t have anything against Sana’s mom. She’s really nice and really pretty. I just also want her to leave us alone for the entire trip so you and me can properly bond.
scene campingtime7
: The whole trip? But I was looking forward to bonding with you as well!
Before I went to sleep last night, I wound up giving Sara a call and explaining the situation to her.
And, since she (and everyone else) has been dying to help me so much lately, she wasted no time at all in accepting the role as Ami’s surrogate mother for the duration of the trip.
Which isn’t to say I expect her to adequately fill that role — especially when there’s one other girl vying for the same position and it’s one Ami seems to like significantly more, but still.

Sara’s already raised children. And, for reasons I will never understand, she seems to love it. So...maybe I’ll get lucky and Ami won’t entirely hate it and I can kind of...pick up a few tricks from her or something.
: You already have a daughter. I don’t want to take Sana’s place.
scene campingtime8
Or maybe she’ll keep deflecting every opportunity Sara takes to try and shorten the gap between them.
: Just because you aren’t my daughter doesn’t mean we can’t bond! We got along well when I came over to your house that one time, didn’t we?
: Wait, really? Ami always tries to kick me out when I go to Sensei’s house.
scene campingtime9
: I wouldn’t have to if you didn’t keep smuggling suitcases full of weird stuff into my living room.
: Wait, Maki — how often are you going over to Sensei’s place?
: Often enough for this to be a recurring problem, apparently.
: Hey, I’m just trying to bump up my sales numbers. You two should be commending me as fellow business owners.
scene campingtime10
: Ami, I would like to apologize on behalf of Maki for any strange objects she may have snuck into your house. And I can assure you that I do not have any strange objects in my possession whatsoever.
: Well, you’re in luck! Because my trunk is full of-
: I would also like to apologize...on behalf of Maki in general.
: It’s fine. I like you. I’m just not in a great mood.
scene campingtime11
: Is it because you were looking forward to spending some alone time with your uncle?
: Yes. And it doesn’t really help that I look like a demon either.
: She’s going through a phase. She’ll break out of it soon, hopefully.
scene campingtime12
: Well, how about this? I just so happen to always travel with a full bag worth of haircare and fashion products, so how about I...fix you up a little bit? Does that sound fun?
: Ami doesn’t need fixing, Sara. Well...not like that at-
: Sure.
scene campingtime13
: Wait, really?
: Yeah, really?!
: Is that really such a surprise? Do you think I like looking like this? I hate it. And being self-conscious about that is one more reason I’m in such a bad mood right now.
: But yes, the other reason is that I wanted to be alone with Sensei. And now I can’t. So that’s just great.
scene campingtime14
: On the bright side, you two will be able to share a tent at least. We were able to find an extra one in Sara’s storage room.
: Haru-kun’s right! The rest of us girls will share a different tent so the two of you can be alone for a little while. Your uncle already informed us of how important that would be.
I did no such thing. But I’m glad to see that Maki’s going out of her way to lie for me.
scene campingtime15
: Can you please stop calling me Haru-kun?
: Unfortunately, I can not. I’m sorry.
: And, I’ll tell you what — if at any point you find me overbearing or annoying, all you have to do is say the word and I’ll leave you alone.
: What word?
: Haru-kun.
scene campingtime16
: Oh, come on!
scene campingtime17
: I’m not asking to be left alone. This is just...a lot at once after not really talking to anybody for weeks.
: It is, isn’t it? But you know what, Ami? I think you’re really brave. And I’m not just saying that because you were able to leave the house looking like that.
scene campingtime18
: I’m saying it because I know what it’s like to feel like a failure. And how you can’t help but blame all of the terrible things happening in the world on some stupid decisions you’ve made.
: Maki feels that way too sometimes, I’m sure. But maybe not Haru-kun since she hasn’t had to experience anything traumatic just yet.
: Knock on wood.
: I’m just not going to get myself involved in this since I can’t imagine anything I have to say doing me any favors.
: How much do you know?...
scene campingtime19
She knows everything.
Well...maybe not everything.
I made sure to leave out the part about how all of this anguish ultimately stems from the fact that I fucked the wrong high-schooler. But she knows about what’s going on with Ami at least.
Truth is, I didn’t want Sara saying the wrong thing since I know she always goes overboard when it comes to parenting. So I told her about the scissors.
I told her about the mental breakdowns and the organ-harvesting rant in the classroom.
I even told her about how Ami’s feelings for me are a bit more than just a niece’s love for her uncle.
if amifingered == True:
But again, I conveniently left out the part about how I’ve reciprocated those feelings on many occasions and have had to wash her dried fluids off my cock more times than I can even count.
The thing is, I trust Sara.
if sarasex == True:
She’s the only one who really gets what I’m going through concerning all of the...blackouts and whatnot.
And I don’t expect her to say the wrong thing because, even if she isn’t the best mom out there, she’s empathetic. And compassionate.
: It doesn’t matter what I know. What matters is what I don’t.
scene campingtime20
And...kind of amazing.
The way she can smile like that after losing a son is something I can only hope to emulate. And all that I’ve lost has had different colored blood than me.
So yeah...the point of this trip is to paint myself in one of those colors and hopefully emerge looking slightly more like a father figure.
But it might be good for me as well — to walk in the shadow of someone who can find the shade and make all of this look whole again.
: Let’s try and have some fun today, okay?
: Even if it’s only for twenty-four hours, let’s pretend like we’ve left Kumon-mi altogether and picture ourselves in a happier place where we can start all over.
: No worries...no drama...just grass. And bugs. And marshmallows. And anything else that Maki has packed into her trunk that won’t make us all look like insatiable nymphomaniacs.
: I’ll try, but...why are you so concerned about how I feel when you barely even know me?...I don’t get it.
: I know more about you than you think, Ami. It’s not like Sensei never talks about you.
scene campingtime21
: Does he?...
: Plus, moms don’t need a reason to be concerned about things like that.
: Even if you’re not Sana, I still feel the need to protect you and nurture you. So that’s what I’m going to do until you ask me to stop. And even then, I’ll never stop feeling this way.

: It just comes with the territory, I guess. And it’s territory I’m sure your uncle’s familiar with if he was worried enough to venture this far out of his comfort zone just to try and make you happy.
scene campingtime22
: Yeah.
: He’s pretty amazing, isn’t he?...
: Not really.
: He really is.
: There’s a part of what you said that needs to be fixed, though.
scene campingtime23
: There is?
: Yeah.
scene sky
: He doesn’t want to be my “uncle” anymore.
: And how does that make you feel?
: You don’t have to answer, Ami.
: I’ll answer.
: Just...
scene black
: I’d like to do it in private.

I’m not sure how long we remain in the car before Maki quite literally ventures off the beaten path down a long dirt road that will either take us to our destination or send us speeding off a nearby cliff.
And if the latter happens, fine. That would actually be a pretty poetic death considering the scenario and the conversations we had leading up to it.
But I’m looking for a different sort of fresh start.
One that will allow me to continue being the sad sack of shit I am, but with a slightly less sad sack of shit looming over me at all times.
Watching my every move.
Always thinking about me.
Less like a niece-
And more like a daughter.
